lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Zhè gè diànyǐng nǐ zěnme kàn?
lines.english: What do you think of this movie?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 我觉得很有意思。故事简单但感人。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde hěn yǒu yìsi. Gùshi jiǎndān dàn gǎnrén.
lines.english: I think it's very interesting. The story is simple but moving.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan lǐmiàn de rén ma?
lines.english: Do you like the people in it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 喜欢。特别是那个男的，很自然。
lines.pinyin: Xǐhuan. Tèbié shì nà gè nán de, hěn zìrán.
lines.english: Yes. Especially that man - very natural.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 音乐也不错。听了让人放心。
lines.pinyin: Yīnyuè yě búcuò. Tīng le ràng rén fàngxīn.
lines.english: The music is good too. Listening puts people at ease.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ míngtiān yě qù kànkan.
lines.english: Then I'll go watch it tomorrow too.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 好主意！看完告诉我你怎么看。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo zhǔyì! Kàn wán gàosu wǒ nǐ zěnme kàn.
lines.english: Good idea! After watching, tell me what you think.
